newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Aboitiz to sign jv with Tyson, Purina unit.
newsitem.headline: Aboitiz to sign jv with Tyson, Purina unit.

text.p: Aboitiz Equity Ventures Inc said on Saturday its Pilmico Foods Corp subsidiary was set to sign a a joint venture with U.S.-based firms Tyson Foods Inc and PM Nutrition Company Inc.

Pilmico and the two U.S. firms will sign a joint venture on Monday to establish an integrated feedmilling and swine operation for the Philippine market at a projected cost of about $25 million, Aboitiz said in a statement.
The project will start in July, it said.
Tyson Foods is a large poultry processor, while PM Nutrition Company is a wholly-owned unit of Purina Mills Inc, a big producer of commercial animal feeds in the U.S.
Aboitiz is a holding company also engaged in power, banking and financial services.
